The '''Shuttle District''' was a district in the [[Old World]] of [[Zakuul]].<ref name="KotFE 7" /> In [[3631 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|4.0}}</ref> during the [[War against Zakuul]], [[Senya Tirall]] and the [[Alliance Commander]] passed the district during their search for the [[SCORPIO|Lady of Sorrows]].<ref name="KotFE 7" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shuttle District appears as an area on Zakuul in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' expansion.<ref name="KotFE 7" />
